subject: Re: BluePeak — Upfront commit: invoice cutover, amortization & accounting next steps
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@bluepeak.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@bluepeak.com>, Finance Ops <ap@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak — Upfront commit: invoice cutover, amortization & accounting next steps

Thanks, Soojin — quick clarifying question from our finance team before we sign: BluePeak's fiscal year ends 2027-12-31. We are committing $2.4M over 3 years (annual prepay, billed up front). To align our internal AR/expense process we need Redwood to issue two invoices: one for the portion attributable to FY2027 (prorated for 8 months of service) and a second invoice that covers the remainder and will be accrued into FY2028/2029. Is Redwood able to: 1) split the invoice across fiscal years with separate invoice numbers, and 2) provide an amortization schedule (ASC 606-friendly) that lists monthly recognized revenue for Redwood?

Also advise if there are any implications for our tax team (should we include a single tax total across invoices or separate taxes per invoice?). Helpful if you can attach a draft invoice and the proposed amortization table.

—Sam
Finance Director, BluePeak Systems
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@bluepeak.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak — Upfront commit: invoice cutover, amortization & accounting next steps

Sam — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can do split invoices with separate invoice numbers and provide an amortization schedule that our finance team signs off on.

Two quick notes before I loop Finance formally: 1) We need to confirm the contract effective date you want us to use for the revenue start (you mentioned 2027-05-01 in the SOW — is that final?). 2) For taxes, Redwood typically issues taxes on each invoice based on the billing address on that invoice; so if BluePeak prefers a single combined tax amount we can explore, but default is per-invoice tax calculation.

I'm attaching a draft invoice split (sheet 1: invoice lines; sheet 2: amortization by month) for internal review. Ben/Laura/Vivek — can you review the attached draft and confirm reconciliation approach (invoice numbering, GL codes to include on the invoice, and suggested revenue recognition lines)? If there are any required wording changes for ASC 606 support (e.g., explicit performance obligation description), please flag them.

Next steps: once Finance confirms, I'll send finalized invoices and DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks — Soojin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T12:07:00Z
Subject: Re: BluePeak — Upfront commit: invoice cutover, amortization & accounting next steps

Looping in finance ops guidance — I reviewed the draft invoice/worksheet Soojin attached. Proposed approach (practical + ASC 606 compliant):

- Invoice A (Invoice# RDW-INV-2027-0041): covers service from 2027-05-01 through 2027-12-31 (8 months) — prorated portion = $640,000 (of the $2.4M total).
- Invoice B (Invoice# RDW-INV-2027-0042): covers the remaining prepaid balance $1,760,000, which BluePeak will capitalize on their side and Redwood will recognize monthly over the remaining 28 months.

Revenue recognition: Redwood will treat the contract as a single performance obligation (managed inference platform access). We'll recognize revenue on a straight-line monthly basis from 2027-05-01 to 2030-04-30 for the full $2.4M, but the accounting entries will reflect the two invoice receipts: cash/deferred revenue entries tied to the invoice numbers. Monthly recognition rows are included on the attached amortization tab.

Tax note: We calculate sales tax by invoice based on the billing address and tax jurisdiction. If BluePeak's AP wants a combined tax number, they should confirm which invoice should be treated as the tax-primary invoice; otherwise we'll keep per-invoice tax lines.

GL codes: we'll add a memo field with Redwood GL prefix "4001" (Platform Subscriptions) and include a custom field for BluePeak's PO number if they provide it.

Action items for Soojin: please confirm the effective date (2027-05-01) and whether BluePeak wants per-invoice taxes or a combined tax approach. Once confirmed, we will finalize invoice numbers and route to DocuSign.

—Ben
Sr. Financial Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-22T15:04:00Z
Subject: BluePeak — Final invoice plan and next steps (DocuSign + payment instructions)

Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the plan below per Ben's guidance: 

1) Effective date: 2027-05-01 (as per SOW) — confirmed by BluePeak.
2) Invoice split: RDW-INV-2027-0041 (amount $640,000) issued today, covers 2027-05-01 through 2027-12-31. RDW-INV-2027-0042 (amount $1,760,000) issued today as the residual prepay invoice. Each invoice will have its own invoice number and tax calculation.
3) Amortization schedule: attached (monthly recognition lines from 2027-05 through 2030-04). Redwood will recognize revenue straight-line across the contract term; finance entries will reference invoice numbers for audit trail.
4) GL & PO: We'll include Redwood GL "4001" and a memo field for BluePeak PO# if you provide it. Please send PO# to ap@redwood.com (or confirm in reply).
5) DocuSign & payment: Sending DocuSign envelope with both invoice PDFs and the signed SOW as exhibits. Payment instructions and wire details are on the invoice PDF. Standard terms: 30 days for invoice A, 30 days for invoice B.

Attachments: BP_Redwood_SOW_signed_v1.pdf; invoice_split_proposal_2027_2028.xlsx (includes amortization table).

If BluePeak is OK with separate tax calculation per invoice, we'll proceed to send the DocuSign envelope and finalize. Please confirm PO# and tax preference by EOD.

Best — Soojin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
